sections.content: Use porque, por eso, por lo tanto, ya que and debido a to explain causes and consequences. Use these connectors to justify a position about rights and responsibilities.

items.english: We have rights because we are citizens.

items.spanish: La regla es necesaria; por eso debemos cumplirla.
items.english: The rule is necessary; therefore we must follow it.

items.spanish: Debido a la situación, cambiaron la norma.
items.english: Because of the situation, they changed the rule.

sections.content: Make the logical relationship explicit: cause explains why something happens, while consequence explains what follows.
